# Queen's Park Women

'''Queen's Park Women''' are a Scottish women's football team based in Glasgow, associated with the men's professional team Queen's Park. They were formed in 1999 as Wellpark before changing to their current name in 2002. They currently play in Scottish Women's Premier League, the highest tier of the national league system. The team play their home matches at Ochilview Park.
